subject: Private Offer & Token Economics — post-call recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Ng <oliver@talonbio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-28T14:05:00Z
Subject: Private Offer & Token Economics — post-call recap and next steps

Hi Oliver — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on during the call: 

Key takeaways
- Expected starting usage: ~0.8M tokens/month with a planned ramp to ~2.5M tokens/month over 3 months. (See attached usage_projection_q2.csv)
- Target unit economics: you indicated a target of roughly $800–$1,000 per 1M tokens as a guideline for procurement budgeting.
- Procurement channel: Talon prefers a marketplace Private Offer (AWS Marketplace preferred) but would like pricing mapped for GCP Marketplace as an alternate.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Oliver / procurement: confirm whether initial PO will be via AWS Private Offer or if procurement needs an invoice route. If AWS PO, please share your AWS Marketplace account ID / Seller acceptance contact.
2) Redwood (Ben + Laura): prepare a short pro-forma showing mapped unit price (USD per 1M tokens) for AWS private offer list price vs. GCP equivalent and an invoiced rate for direct billing.
3) Marissa: propose two private-offer unit price bands we can present (baseline and accelerated ramp).

Attached: usage_projection_q2.csv (projected token ramp), po_template_private_offer.xlsx (sample fields for marketplace PO).

Proposed internal sync: Wed 3/30 10:00am PT — Ben/Laura/Marissa to map marketplace conversions and finalize numbers to send to Talon. If that works for you, Oliver, we will send an updated table before EOD 3/30.

Thanks — Marissa

--

From: Oliver Ng <oliver@talonbio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-29T01:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Private Offer & Token Economics — post-call recap and next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful summary. A couple clarifications from our side: 
- Initial procurement plan is to go through AWS Marketplace Private Offer if we can get a clear mapping to our budgeted $/1M tokens. If necessary we can do a direct invoice, but that adds procurement lead time.
- Usage: our conservative scenario is 0.8M tokens/mo for the first month, then 1.5M in month two, and up to 2.5M in month three if the pilot metrics look good. See that aligns with your projection file.
- Budget: finance prepared a flexible band of $10k–$20k/month depending on demonstrated token efficiency; they asked for a pro-forma showing final customer cost at $/1M tokens so they can model the PO.

Could you share a simple table that shows: listed private-offer unit price (AWS), the equivalent GCP marketplace unit, and a direct-invoice unit — all expressed as $ per 1M tokens? Also confirm whether marketplace billing will be monthly via AWS (preferred) or per-usage invoice.

If you can get that to me before Wed EOD, procurement will fast-track the PO creation.

—Oliver
VP Ops, Talon Bio
procurement@talonbio.com

Subject: Re: Private Offer & Token Economics — post-call recap and next steps

Oliver — thanks for the quick clarifications. Below is a concise pro-forma based on the ramp you outlined and our typical marketplace mappings. This is a starting point for procurement — final private-offer numbers will require a short internal approval for marketplace discounting.

Pro-forma (USD per 1M tokens)
- AWS Private Offer (list suggested baseline): $1,050 / 1M tokens
- GCP Marketplace (equivalent list): $1,150 / 1M tokens
- Direct invoice (customer account billing): $1,000 / 1M tokens

Notes on mapping and assumptions
- Marketplace takes a platform fee/commissions that we partially absorb when we extend a private offer; the AWS private-offer baseline above reflects a conservative 5–10% absorption we can discuss.
- If Talon commits to a 3-month ramp to 2.5M with a 6–12 month term, we can propose an accelerated band: $850 / 1M tokens (direct invoice) and $900 / 1M tokens (AWS PO) subject to committed monthly minimums.
- Billing cadence: AWS Marketplace will bill Talon monthly through the marketplace (preferred by your procurement) — settlement timing depends on AWS terms; direct invoiced billing would be net-30 by Redwood.

Quick math examples
- Conservative month (0.8M): at $1,050/1M (AWS PO) => roughly $840/month
- Ramp month (1.5M): at $900/1M (accelerated PO) => $1,350/month
- Peak month (2.5M): at $850/1M (direct invoice aggressive) => $2,125/month

Action: Ben/Laura and I will produce a short private-offer worksheet (mapping fields required by AWS PO) and a simple PDF pro-forma. Can we run internal mapping Wed 3/30 10am PT (confirmed) and have the pro-forma back to you by Wed EOD?

Regards,
Marissa

Ben/Laura — forwarding the thread and the request from Talon. Quick internal notes/asks before our 10am sync:

1) Confirm whether we can offer the accelerated AWS PO band at $900/1M conditional on a 3-month ramp + 6 month term. If not, what is the minimum accepted concession?
2) I'll need a filled PO template for AWS Marketplace: seller SKU, buyer AWS account mapping, pricing fields, and Marketplace charges line. Ben can you pull the standard PO template and pref-fill where possible?
3) Laura — can you prepare the pro-forma PDF with the three columns (AWS PO / GCP PO / Direct Invoice) and include the three example months shown in my email so procurement has a clear cost model to present to finance.

If you want to adjust any of the proposed numbers before the call, flag them now — otherwise we'll lock these bands for the customer deliverable.

Thanks — Marissa
